lspBroker.method: Fake stdio LSP server; 180 ms injected initialize delay; one cold attach followed by 20 sequential shared attaches. P50/P95 use nearest-rank indexes over the shared samples. Crash fallback kills the broker-owned fake LSP process and times the next hover through private takeover.
lspBroker.memoryNote: The broker ran in the Vitest process for deterministic protocol tests, so broker-only RSS is not isolated. The fake language server reported its own RSS.
